title: Menu
lead: Create reusable navigation trees and deliver them through portable template keys or direct Mustache data.

sections.title: Create and edit
steps: Enter a name and stable ID. Choose the navigation type for direct Mustache data.
Add page, anchor, URL or group items. Use parents and ordering to build up to five levels; enable items and choose new-tab behavior as needed.
Save and reopen to confirm the items. Only eligible public page targets are rendered; the receiving layout controls appearance.

sections.title: Choose a delivery channel
steps: Template key selects portable keys from installed manifests, without selecting or binding a template. Each key has its own presentation format.
Any template declaring the same typed Menu key can receive the menu, even when it maps that key to another physical location.
Mustache key exposes menu.ID-or-slug data without destination fields. Saved template keys remain inactive and preserved; template mode blocks direct ID/slug references.

sections.title: Compatibility and safe switching
steps: Missing keys or unsupported format/depth produce an admin warning and unavailable public menu data. They do not prevent saving or produce a public compatibility error.
Unavailable keys remain editable for future templates. Claiming a key replaces its other active portable owner in the same revision-checked save; history preserves recovery.
Legacy per-template bindings are retained. Saving through this editor adopts portable keys; reads never migrate existing content.

sections.title: Render the public tree
steps: Use menu.ID-or-slug.items in Mustache mode or template.key.items for a declared Menu position. Explicit id and slug selectors are also supported.
Items contain label, href, slug, anchor, newTab and children. Use finite sections and inverted sections; preserve safe link behavior and keep markup in the receiving layout.

sections.title: Overview and recovery
steps: Search and clear filters with the icon controls. Column headers change ordering; the pager preserves filters and shows result/page totals.
Use Trash for recoverable removal and History to restore earlier catalogs. Concurrent changes are rejected without overwriting the saved catalog.
